guarantees.claim: On reset (rst_ni low), process_valid is cleared to 0 at the next clock edge.
When start_i is asserted (after reset) and process_i is not being evaluated in the same cycle, process_valid is set to 1.
When process_i is asserted and start_i is low, process_valid is cleared to 0.
When none of reset, start_i, or process_i conditions are true, process_valid retains its previous value (no assignment).

uncertain_points.claim: If start_i and process_i are simultaneously asserted at a clock edge, start_i takes priority and process_valid is set to 1, losing the clearing effect of process_i.
uncertain_points.cond: start_i && process_i both true at posedge clk_i
uncertain_points.risk: The external logic may expect process_valid to be cleared by the process_i pulse; instead it stays 1, potentially stalling the handshake or causing a missed transaction.
